title: Yaroslav and Time
statementMd:
Yaroslav is playing a game called "Time". The game has a timer showing the lifespan he's got left. As soon as the timer shows 0, Yaroslav's character dies and the game ends. Also, the game has $*n*$ clock stations, station number $*i*$ is at point $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$ of the plane. As the player visits station number $*i*$, he increases the current time on his timer by $*a*_{*i*}$. The stations are for one-time use only, so if the player visits some station another time, the time on his timer won't grow.

A player spends $*d*·*dist*$ time units to move between stations, where $*dist*$ is the distance the player has covered and $*d*$ is some constant. The distance between stations $*i*$ and $*j*$ is determined as $|*x*_{*i*} - *x*_{*j*}| + |*y*_{*i*} - *y*_{*j*}|$.

Initially, the player is at station number $1$, and the player has strictly more than zero and strictly less than one units of time. At station number $1$ one unit of money can increase the time on the timer by one time unit (you can buy only integer number of time units).

Now Yaroslav is wondering, how much money he needs to get to station $*n*$. Help Yaroslav. Consider the time to buy and to increase the timer value negligibly small.

## Input

The first line contains integers $*n*$ and $*d*$ $(3 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 10^{3} ≤ *d* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of stations and the constant from the statement.

The second line contains $*n* - 2$ integers: $*a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, ..., *a*_{*n* - 1}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{3})$. The next $*n*$ lines contain the coordinates of the stations. The $*i*$-th of them contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$ $($-$100 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 100)$.

It is guaranteed that no two stations are located at the same point.

## Output

In a single line print an integer — the answer to the problem.
statementZhMd:
Yaroslav 正在玩一款名为“Time”的游戏。游戏中有一个计时器，显示他剩余的生命时间。当计时器显示为 0 时，Yaroslav 的角色会死亡，游戏结束。游戏中还有 $*n*$ 个时间站点，编号为 $*i*$ 的站点位于平面上的点 $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$。玩家访问编号为 $*i*$ 的站点时，计时器上的当前时间会增加 $*a*_{*i*}$。每个站点只能使用一次，因此如果玩家再次访问某个站点，计时器上的时间不会增加。

玩家在站点之间移动时，每移动 $*dist*$ 的距离需要花费 $*d*·*dist*$ 个时间单位，其中 $*dist*$ 是玩家移动的距离，$*d*$ 是题目中给定的常数。站点 $*i*$ 与站点 $*j*$ 之间的距离定义为 $|*x*_{*i*} - *x*_{*j*}| + |*y*_{*i*} - *y*_{*j*}|$。

初始时，玩家位于编号为 1 的站点，且计时器上的时间严格大于 0 且严格小于 1。在编号为 1 的站点，花费 1 单位金钱可以使计时器上的时间增加 1 个时间单位（只能购买整数个时间单位）。

现在 Yaroslav 想知道，要到达编号为 $*n*$ 的站点，他至少需要多少钱。请帮助 Yaroslav。购买时间以及增加计时器数值所需的时间可以忽略不计。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*d*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 10^{3} ≤ *d* ≤ 10^{5}$），分别表示站点数量以及题目中所述的常数。

第二行包含 $*n* - 2$ 个整数：$*a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, ..., *a*_{*n* - 1}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{3}$）。接下来的 $*n*$ 行包含各个站点的坐标。其中第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$（$-$100 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 100）。

保证没有两个站点位于同一点。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个整数，即问题的答案。
